infrastructure_notes: No Swift toolchain was preinstalled; Swift 6.1 (ubuntu24.04-aarch64) was installed under $HOME/toolchains plus libxml2/libicu under $HOME/.local/lib to run swift test on this host.

Pre-existing defect (not caused by this change, unfixed because bin/ is outside permitted paths): bin/lint's non-Apple harness excludes PaletteAPIClient.swift yet compiles PaletteAPIClientTests, so bin/lint cannot build on Linux. Direct swift test builds the FULL package (including PaletteAPIClient.swift and BrightnessGridSampler.swift) and passes 228/228; the harness exclusions are stale with current toolchains and should be dropped when Package.swift is next touched.
One pre-existing compile error in PaletteAPIClientTests.swift (missing explicit self. in a @Sendable closure under Swift 6.1) was fixed within the test file to unblock the suite.
The solver parity replay was independently cross-checked with an exact IEEE-754 double reimplementation in Python against the corpus before the Swift suite was written.
